research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Vena Vitals is engaged in developing a multi-channel array sensor for spatiotemporal signal tracking, as described in the system for tracking a measured signal and utilizing spatiotemporal data to adjust the measured signal. This technology involves a sensor array with multiple sensors, each capable of measuring various parameters, and an electronic board for processing, aligning with efforts to create soft wearable sensors for continuous blood pressure monitoring.

overview_description.description: Vena Vitals makes a small wearable device that monitors blood pressure continuously. The company has demonstrated accuracy of its devices in the operating room and ICU head to head against the invasive arterial line. Target applications focus on the clinical space everywhere that blood pressure may be used.
